scope: Embedding-only bank additions; real pretrained GPU canaries have not been run on this host.

capability.explanation: Official encode/decode API, 100 raw bits with ECC disabled; author checksums enforced before model load. GPU and saved-PNG identity canary remain required.

notes: A checkpoint variant of TrustMark, not an independent architecture.
Official native encode uses uint8 truncation and mean-removed/interpolated residuals. This is recorded, not replaced by a guessed Q implementation.
Prepared files are SHA256 inventoried. Upstream-published MD5 is additionally checked at initialization.

capability.explanation: Official variant-P API retains its 1.25 native strength multiplier and 224px decoder. 100 raw bits, ECC disabled. Real-weight saved-PNG canary remains required.

notes: A checkpoint variant of TrustMark, not an independent architecture.
Official P native defaults differ from B/Q; these are retained and recorded.
Official uint8 truncation precedes external scalar-only Matched Quality.

assets.provenance: Author HEAVY FED committed at the pinned revision
Author HEAVY inverse-noise layer required by decode.py

capability.explanation: Concrete FED/INL inference and strict state loading. Native FIN128 is transferred to the RGB512 carrier by explicit residual resizing; its clean recovery requires a real-image canary.

notes: Native here means selected FIN HEAVY plus disclosed resolution adaptation, not an unmodified 512px author network.
Encoder messages are {-0.5,+0.5}; decoder applies inverse INL then inverse FED, threshold zero.
No JPEG or other demo-time attack is applied during embedding.
Failed identity decoding must be reported; do not silently switch FIN variant or tune residual strength to pass.

assets.provenance: Official OmniSealBench scripts/download_image_models.sh FNNS checkpoint; SHA256 captured on preparation

capability.explanation: Pinned OmniSealBench FNNS image-optimization algorithm and pretrained TorchScript decoder. 16 fixed prefix bits + 2 deterministic filler bits + 30 common bits; GPU identity canary unrun.

notes: The orchestrator must honor payload_layout.fixed_prefix; ordinary all-random padding is rejected.
Optimization requires image gradients; do not use global inference_mode/no_grad for embed.
Upstream build_model fixes initialization seed42, with Adam lr0.5, 10 steps and lambda_w1.3; retained without identity-driven tuning.
Only the root benchmark initializer is bypassed to avoid importing unrelated audio infrastructure; image model source executes unchanged.

assets.provenance: Official cards/detector_dc-ae.yaml includes post-hoc embedder and extractor; dimensions and strict load checked at initialization

capability.explanation: Concrete official post-hoc latent path on existing RGB512 images. Pretrained inference on the target GPU and saved-PNG decoding are untested here.

notes: No text-to-image/diffusion generator is loaded; this is the existing-image post-hoc mode.
Native output includes DC-AE reconstruction change; quality reference must remain original COCO, never reconstructed unmarked output.
Uses scaling_w0.5 from the inference model card, not the training schedule initial value1.5.
The fixed generation-time signature .npy file is intentionally not loaded: the selected post-hoc embedder receives our arbitrary 64-bit payload.
Do not promise that Matched39/42/45 preserves decodability; coverage and identity BER must be reported independently.
